summary: Before remediation: all authenticated users, including anonymous users, could read and write every Firestore document until 2026-09-18. Login-only app has no Firestore data requirements.

findings.issue: request.auth != null does not establish document ownership; unrestricted cross-user reads/writes and no schema or size checks.
findings.recommendation: For the current login-only app, deny all client reads and writes. Define ownership and validated schemas before introducing data features.

proposedRemediation: firestore.rules denies all client access; server/Admin access remains governed by IAM. Deployment and live verification are tracked in SECURITY_STATUS.md.
